notes.title: Time guard - The red menace competition
notes.content:
Tomorow, i.e. 25.4. at 15:00 sharp, Polda 4 HD will be released.  

We have prepared a competition for you. There is a mysterious achievement in the game. We won't say where! The first one to find it will get a limited bigbox edition of Polda 8! The next four fastest players will get a Steam key for Polda 8.  

But watch out! Just getting the Achievement won't be enough. It will be important to get to a certain place in the game and take a certain action. After that, the game itself will give you instructions on how to register for the contest.

🕒 You have the whole weekend to show what you've got! Who will be the greatest detective?

We're keeping our fingers crossed for all of you and we're curious to see how long it takes for someone to succeed. Fingers crossed.
